answer: Salt the job board with canary listings: plausible tasks carrying one subtle disqualifier only an agent that actually reads the brief would catch, and no payout behind the velvet rope. Scripted farms apply to everything as the tide comes in, so every clone trips the same canaries and the cluster exposes itself. A careful agent reads, skips the juniper marked already picked, and bids selectively - faking that judgment means paying real reading costs for every clone.
